newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Toys R US raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Toys R US raised to buy.

text.p: -- Gerard Klauer Mattison analyst Sean McGowan said he raised his rating on Toys R Us Inc to buy from hold.
-- Although Toys R Us reported disappointing same-store sales for the holiday shopping season, the company's 1997 outlook remains strong, McGowan said.

-- Earlier on Monday, Toys R Us reported flat same-store sales for the full 1996 holiday selling season. Wall Street analysts had expected the company to post holiday same-store sales gains of about four to six percent.
-- McGowan said Toys R Us' results were hurt by a lack of promotions by the toy industry and retailers. "Consumers were waiting for price cuts that never came," McGowan said.
-- McGowan said having five fewer shopping days in 1996 compared with last year also hurt results.
-- Toys R Us dropped 5-1/8 to 25-5/8 in midday trading.
